peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM, WHICH IS GENUINELY BETTER THAN THIS ASSET'S REPUTATION. The MakerDAO-fork vault model is a REAL STRUCTURAL IMPROVEMENT over the algorithmic design it replaced, and the PSM provides a clean exit. ⚠️ SCORING THE MECHANISM HONESTLY MATTERS MOST WHERE THE OTHER AXES ARE WEAK: 4.0 is the highest score on this asset, and docking it further on issuer or collateral grounds would double-count concerns priced at 2.0 and 3.0 respectively. ⚠️ THE MECHANISM IS NOT THE PROBLEM HERE — the counterparty and the control are.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_cross_axis: ⚠️ A PSM IS ONLY AS GOOD AS ITS INVENTORY AND ITS OPERATOR. This score prices the design; whether the operator would keep it open under stress is the issuer question, priced at 2.0.

backing.backing_score_basis: ⚠️ MEASURES COUNTERPARTY CONCENTRATION IN THE COLLATERAL, NOT A COVERAGE RATIO. ≈70.8% OF COLLATERAL COMES FROM ONE COUNTERPARTY (HTX), AND THE CONCENTRATION TICKED **UP** rather than down. ⚠️ A COLLATERAL RATIO ABOVE 100% MEANS LITTLE WHEN SEVEN-TENTHS OF THE COLLATERAL DEPENDS ON ONE EXCHANGE REMAINING SOLVENT AND COOPERATIVE — the arithmetic and the exposure are different questions, and this axis prices the second. ⚠️ AND THE COUNTERPARTY IS AFFILIATED WITH THE ISSUER, so this is not an arms-length collateral relationship; concentration and governance are the same fact seen twice.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — collateral concentration, not a spot ratio

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: ⚠️ MEASURES WHERE THE VOLUME IS, NOT HOW MUCH. 24h volume ≈$4–5M — ⚠️ BUT IT IS CONCENTRATED ON SUN-CONTROLLED VENUES, so the observed liquidity and the issuer are not independent, and a stress event affecting the issuer would affect the venue on which holders would exit. ✅ PSM exit on Ethereum has improved and is the leg least exposed to that. ⚠️ VOLUME ON A RELATED-PARTY VENUE IS NOT THE SAME EVIDENCE AS VOLUME ON AN INDEPENDENT ONE, and a depth figure cannot tell them apart.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue independence, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ NO COMPUTED DEPTH EXISTS — the feed carries no liquidity block for this asset.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: New USDD and USDDOLD must not share an assumed issuer/reserve perimeter. Retain the legacy issuer mark provisionally: an interface labelled USDD Team does not establish a registered dollar repayment obligor or unconditional reserve title. July2026 interface terms impose geographic restrictions and broad amendment/disclaimer powers. Chain-specific technical audits do not establish reserve assurance, issuer licensing or a complete governance execution path.
